messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: detected sustained 5xx spike from EU inference fleet (eu-west-1). alert: eu-inference-5xx-rate > 2% for 3m. Severity: P2. auto-escalation to on-call.

sara: acked. I'm oncall — looking now. seeing ~3.8% 5xx on the EU frontends and latency up ~120ms p95. :eyes:

raj: grabbing logs from the inference ingress. quick check: increased request fanout to shard-2, backend pods OOMKilled earlier? pulling kube events.

carla: I'm watching autoscaler — no recent scale up for dedicated pools in eu-west-1, CPU nodes at 78%.

sara: can we confirm customer impact? any admin tickets or spike in error reports?

michael: checking support queue — 2 customers reported degraded responses in EU in the last 10m. not full outage but elevated errors on generation requests. tagging as possible customer-affecting.

raj: paste logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T12:10:23Z] 5xx from model-proxy shard-2: OOMError: failed to allocate KV cache
[2026-03-14T12:10:24Z] Restarting container model-proxy-2
```

carla: looks like model-proxy restarts caused momentary backlog. the HPA didn't trigger because memory requests are pinned. we need to either increase replica count or adjust mem requests.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily shift traffic away from eu-west-1 to eu-central-1 for non-region-locked requests; 2) bump model-proxy replicas in eu-west-1; 3) silence the noisy 5xx alert while we stabilize to avoid alert fatigue. I'll implement 1 and 2.

olivia: +1 on traffic shift, we should use the traffic-routing policy (route-policy: latency-first) and set a 10% gradual shift initially.

sara: executing traffic shift now. command:
```
redwoodctl route update --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --pct 10 --policy gradual
```

incident-bot: Action logged: route change submitted by sara at 2026-03-14T12:14:05Z. Change ID: rchg-20260314-17

carla: scaling model-proxy in eu-west-1 to 6 -> 10 replicas.
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/model-proxy-eu-west --replicas=10
```

sara: suppressing alert eu-inference-5xx-rate for 30m to avoid noise while mitigations progress.

michael: I adjusted Grafana alert thresholds temporarily: eu-inference-5xx-rate alert now fires at >4% for 10m instead of 2% for 3m. I'm adding a note in the alert description with a link to this thread.

sara: after traffic shift + scale, 5xx dropped to 1.2% over the next 5m. latency p95 back to baseline ~60ms. :thumbsup:

raj: root cause likely memory pressure on model-proxy (KV cache growth with certain request patterns) causing OOMs and restarts -> downstream 5xx. need longer term: mem tuning or evict cache earlier and better oom handling.

olivia: I'll take the 2nd shift/handoff in 20m. sara pls leave notes for the next oncall.

sara: oncall handoff notes: current status stable, traffic shifted 10% to eu-central-1, model-proxy replicas scaled to 10, temporary alert threshold bumped, suppression active until 12:44Z. follow-ups: create dedicated EU memory dashboard, add a failover runbook step for gradual route shifts, and add an alert that fires on restart rate for model-proxy (>=3 restarts in 10m).

michael: I'll create the dashboard tile and new alert rule. dashboard draft: "EU model-proxy health" with panels: restart rate, RSS mem usage per pod, KV cache size, incoming rps. Will link to runbook.

carla: opened RFC: change memory requests for model-proxy workloads to allow HPA to scale. assigning to infra team.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration so far: 00:34:00. Severity downgraded to P3. Event ID: inc-20260314-eu-5xx

olivia: acking handoff. I'll keep monitoring for 2h and will escalate if restarts recur. leaving a reminder to revert alert thresholds after postmortem.

sara: thanks everyone. postmortem actions: (1) add restart-rate alert, (2) dashboard + dashboard link in runbook, (3) plan memory req/limit change and QA in staging, (4) revisit routing policy for region-failover. tagging owners: michael (dash/alerts), carla (infra), raj (root cause and remediation), olivia (oncall follow-up).

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: sara -> olivia at 2026-03-14T12:44:00Z. Next oncall: olivia.

michael: logging follow-up ticket: INFR-7212 created with the dashboard and alert tasks, link: https://tickets.internal/redwood/INFR-7212

sara: closing thread for now; will open a full postmortem doc tomorrow with timelines and customer impact summary. :white_check_mark:
